commits.messageBody:
Include Windows declarations in the vendor source prefix and avoid the legacy __in/__out SAL names colliding with iterator parameters. Installed STLport headers and allocator routing remain unchanged. Native v120 Release compiled all 33 static-library translation units on Win32 and x64; runtime integration is still pending.

(cherry picked from commit 92b05cbd89e1a8af59ba17283803361bc4402ccf)
commits.messageHeadline: stlport: use native SDK declarations when building library sources
